hostPreparationStages.interpretation: All10 values are actual Host helper wall timers. Capture includes App-lock wait and encoding; queued progress span includes waiting before the single worker starts. Completed preparation is not a finalized business transaction. Missing or unfinished preparation is not measured zero. A zero retry-wait field means the successful helper never entered its5ms crossing retry; it is excluded from duration samples and counted as not invoked. Total and children are not added twice.

coverage.interpretation: Exact per-preparation subtraction of nested wall intervals. Outside-helper time includes queue, worker result delivery and coordinator scheduling/logging; it is not a direct queue-wait measurement. Inside-helper unattributed time is not a named operation or CPU measurement. Residuals are not added across overlapping transactions, and quantiles must not be subtracted. Only completed preparations with all10 actual timers are included, even if no verified callback completed; missing and unfinished preparations have no residual sample.
